summary_1line: Parasara teaches that righteous wealth, generosity, fulfilling debts to gods and beings, and humble service to elders and sacred duties lead to true merit.

image_candidates.scene_text: A humble householder offers a bowl of cool water to a weary traveler standing at his doorway under the hot sun.
King Rantideva reverently serves ascetics simple offerings of roots, fruits, and leaves in a forest hermitage.
Ancient rishis sit in meditation before a sacred fire, chanting hymns to Vishnu as flames rise into the night sky.
